title: Member Courtesy Percentage on Tailwise Pharmacy Error Refunds
content:
*Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus benefit schedule, service recovery.*

The courtesy percentage on a Tailwise Pharmacy dispensing-error refund follows the customer's Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership, as the membership record shows its tier and its status.

| Membership tier | Membership status | Courtesy percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Tailwise Plus Monthly, Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | active | 20 percent |
| Pals Rewards VIP | active | 15 percent |
| any other tier (Pals Rewards Member, Pals Rewards Insider) | any | none |
| any tier | past due, pending downgrade or closed | none |
| no membership | | none |

The courtesy amount is the courtesy percentage of the amount the courtesy is figured on. The courtesy amount is rounded half up to the cent on its own before it is added to the refund.

## Points of judgement

- Tier and status are read together: a Tailwise Plus Annual membership in status past due takes no courtesy percentage, and neither does a Pals Rewards VIP membership that is closed.
- Pals Rewards Member and Pals Rewards Insider take no courtesy percentage whatever their status.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Amount the courtesy is figured on $74.45, Tailwise Plus Monthly, active: 20 percent is $14.89; courtesy amount $14.89.
- Amount figured on $37.33, Pals Rewards VIP, active: 15 percent is $5.5995, rounded half up on its own to $5.60.
- Amount figured on $64.00, Pals Rewards Insider, active: no courtesy percentage, so no courtesy amount.
